Actual queued job cancellation prevents provider work and is idempotent
Actual process exit leaves interrupted state after restart with no invented audio

Voice fingerprint changes with voice/conditioning while excluding credentials
Canonical artifact reads are pinned to version and SHA256; missing/tampered cache fails closed
Console narrate/retry/source-conflict flows exercise actual HTTP and never show fabricated playback
shared_dependency: Canonical artifact audio kind and MIME support supplied by the music lane
remaining_limits: Actual provider speech generation, successful cache reuse and audible playback remain external-provider qualification pending
No simultaneous multiplayer or voice-input participation is claimed
Root registers final shared integration and hosted variant independently
